title: Modified Shields' formula for critical velocity of scour

symbols.definition: critical velocity of flow beyond which particles of a certain size and density once settled may be again placed in motion
3 to 4.5; a value of 4.0 is usually adopted for grit particles
Specific gravity of grit particle, dimensionless

applicability: The critical velocity for scour of settled grit particles in a grit chamber, calculated from the modified Shields formula.
notes: where Kc = 3 to 4.5. A value of 4.0 is usually adopted for grit particles.
For a grit particle size of 0.2 mm, the formula gives critical velocity values of 17.1 to 25.6 cm/sec.
No symbol list is printed under equation (5.12); g and d are not redefined on this page.
